issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event/Key Insights sections use undefined jargon: "Probe rp-mtk46lj8-90q9av and review rr-mtk4acx4-oqze5c are bound before development starts" and "The repro review is red-reviewed and classified as target-bug" never explain what a repro probe, a rp-/rr- id, "red-reviewed", or the "target-bug" classification mean. These terms are documented only in docs/requirements/decisions/*.md (e.g. experience-layer-fresh-failure-recurrence-execution-plan.md, proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md), not in CLAUDE.md or background.md itself, so a fresh reader with no conversation history cannot understand this section from the text alone.

background.md Solution Tradeoffs section says the story "avoids pretending candidate evidence is verificationEvidence, DONE evidence, Authority proof, or production proof" -- "Authority proof" and "production proof" are capitalized/specific jargon terms with no inline definition and no mention in CLAUDE.md, so a fresh reader cannot tell what distinguishes them from ordinary DONE evidence or why they are listed as things to avoid pretending.

Internal inconsistency between background.md and the checklist: Solution Tradeoffs explicitly states "Candidate global-cli-worktree-drift remains intake evidence only" (i.e. NOT confirmed by a RED reproduction, unlike the exec-bit defect which has probe rp-mtk46lj8-90q9av / review rr-mtk4acx4-oqze5c bound). Yet checklist item CHK-003 ("Make doctor verify the global executable realpath ...") implements a fix for exactly that unconfirmed worktree-drift/realpath candidate (context literally says "Draft symptom: /opt/homebrew/bin/proof-or-stop resolved into .worktrees/B-fe8f"), with no RED/GREEN evidence pair analogous to CHK-001/CHK-002. This folds unverified candidate scope into a story whose own stated tradeoff is to avoid treating candidate evidence as proven.
